notes: Sample when decisions.md has ## Testability pass: each hard-gated Negative and Overlooked idea appears in acceptance[] (or as Deferred test idea: <id> - <reason> in decisions.md). Edge is optional when used. Positive remains prefer-only unless also Strategy Top risk/Charter.

tasks.title: Cover hard-gated Negative Test Idea with acceptance
acceptance: Negative: neg-missing-evidence - claim ready when hard-gated Negative acceptance lacks fresh evidence → VERDICT: REFUTED

tasks.title: Cover hard-gated Overlooked Test Idea with acceptance
acceptance: Overlooked: overlooked-unmapped-idea - Overlooked idea mapped to acceptance with matching fresh evidence → VERDICT: VERIFIED

tasks.title: Optional Edge coverage when Testability Edge is used
acceptance: Edge: edge-partial-deferral - Deferred test idea: overlooked-x - out of size covers deferred idea while sibling hard-gate gap remains REFUTED
tasks.notes: Edge optional when Testability Edge is present; not hard-gated unless also Strategy Top risk/Charter
